colleges.about: JB Institute of Technology is a private technical institute established in 2009 at Uttarakhand. The institute is affiliated to the Uttarakhand Board of Technical Education, Roorkee & Uttarakhand Technical University. It is approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE) and Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). The JB Institute of Technology Dehradun courses are provided at diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Popular degrees include D.Pharma, B.Tech, BBA and MBA. The JBIT Dehradun fees for the courses range from Rs 50,250 to Rs 93,900 annually. Both previous academic merit along with valid entrance test scores are required for the JB Institute of Technology Dehradun course admissions. Exams such as JEE Main, GATE, JEEP, etc. are considered.
colleges.courses_text: JBIT Dehradun offers a diverse array of courses at both undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) levels, covering a wide spectrum of disciplines including engineering, management, pharmacy, and more. Additionally, the institution provides diploma courses in pharmacy and engineering. colleges.placement_text: JB Institute of Technology Dehradun placement 2023 data has not been published by the official authorities. However, the placement statistics for the year 2022 were released, according to which 257 job offers were made and 145 students were placed. The JB Institute of Technology placement rate was recorded at 96.69%. The top recruiting companies included Erricson, Tech Mahindra, Havells, Birla Soft, etc. The JB Institute of Technology Dehradun average package offered to the students was Rs 4 LPA. Throughout the years, 150+ MNCs have conducted Solo/ Off Campus/ Pool placement drives for the students of JBIT Dehradun. The placement cell ensures that all the students secure job opportunities in their preferred roles and companies. The JB Institute of Technology Dehradun highest package recorded was Rs 7 LPA. Other than this, summer internship placements are also provided for students to gain appropriate experience and knowledge through hands on training sessions.

colleges.college_full_name: Uttaranchal College of Paramedical & Allied Sciences
colleges.about: Uttaranchal College of Paramedical & Allied Sciences, established in 2024, is a premier educational institution dedicated to offering high-quality education in the field of paramedical and allied sciences. The college is strategically nestled in the serene mountain ranges of the Himalayas, offering a tranquil and inspiring environment conducive to learning. It is located near the picturesque cities of Dehradun and Rishikesh, both renowned for their natural beauty, spiritual significance, and vibrant tourism. This location attracts a diverse range of visitors, from tourists and pilgrims to nature enthusiasts and adventure seekers, making it a hub for individuals from various walks of life. The college offers three specialized undergraduate programs: BMLT (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology), BMRIT (Bachelor of Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology), and BSc. Optometry. These programs provide students with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills, preparing them for careers in medical laboratories, radiology, imaging, and optometry. The curriculum covers key areas such as diagnostic techniques, medical imaging, and vision care. All programs are affiliated with Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University (HNBMU), ensuring a high standard of education to help students excel in the growing paramedical field.
colleges.courses_text: Uttaranchal College of Paramedical & Allied Sciences offers a variety of undergraduate programs in the field of science. These include the Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) and Bachelor of Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology (BMRIT), both of which are 3-year regular courses with an intake of 30 students each. Additionally, the college offers a 4-year BSc. Optometry program, also with 30 seats available. All courses are delivered through regular classroom sessions, and admissions are based on entrance exams.
colleges.placement_text: The placement cell at Uttaranchal College of Paramedical and Allied Sciences actively helps students secure jobs in hospitals, diagnostic labs, rehabilitation centers, and research institutes. In the past years, the institute has seen a placement success rate of over 90%, with students recruited by Fortis, Apollo, Max Healthcare, AIIMS, and other renowned healthcare organizations. The average salary package ranges from ₹3 LPA to ₹6 LPA, depending on the course and specialization. Internship placements are also offered as part of the curriculum to help students gain real-world experience
colleges.campus_text: UCPAS offers a well-equipped campus with PhD-qualified faculty members who have over 10 years of medical experience. The campus features fully air-conditioned digital lecture halls, Wi-Fi connectivity, state-of-the-art laboratories, and an in-campus 100-bed hospital, providing students with practical exposure from the first year. Additionally, the college offers scholarships for underprivileged students, on-campus sports facilities (basketball, volleyball, badminton), and in-house cafes for convenience. Accommodation is provided through double-occupancy hostels within the campus, ensuring a comfortable living experience.
colleges.awards_text: The institute has been recognized for its contributions to healthcare education and has received accolades from various academic and industry bodies. It is known for producing skilled healthcare professionals who contribute to hospitals, clinics, and research institutions across India.
colleges.ranking_text: Uttaranchal College of Paramedical and Allied Sciences has gained recognition as one of the leading paramedical institutes in Uttarakhand, known for its high-quality education, research-driven approach, and excellent clinical training facilities. Though specific national rankings may not be available, the institute is well-regarded among paramedical institutions in the region.

colleges.about: IIT Varanasi has opened its admission for the academic session 2025-2026. Indian Institute of Technology Varanasi earlier known as the Banaras Engineering College was established in 1919, and in 2012 it was renamed the Institute of Technology of India Banaras Hindu University. It has become a prominent place where thousands of students come every year to shape their careers. In 1968, three colleges, Banaras Engineering College (founded in 1919), College of Technology, and College of Mining and Metallurgy merged and became the IIT BHU to provide more facilities to the engineering students. Later in 2012, it was named as Indian Institute of Technology, Varanasi. The institute is approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and All India Council for Technical Education(AICTE) and has top faculties, an excellent placement cell, well-equipped labs, on-campus hostels, clubs, and many other facilities to offer students. The institute has been gaining popularity among students all over India even international students for its placement-oriented quality education in the fields of Engineering, Technology and Science.  The IIT BHU courses are offered at UG, PG and PhD levels, in the field of engineering and applied science. The degrees offered are B.Tech, B.Arch, B.Tech + M.Tech, M.Tech, M.Sc and PhD. The institute also offers part-time courses alongside regular courses for both domestic and international students. The IIT Varanasi fees range from Rs 10,000 to Rs 1,00,000 per semester (tuition fee).  The IIT BHU placements are organised by the dedicated and very active Training and Placement Cell (T&P Cell). 100% placement assistance is provided to the students. In recent placements, the IIT Varanasi's highest package recorded was Rs1.68 crore per annum. The top recruiters were Unilever, Visa, Jio, Myntra, Bajaj, Intel, HP, MasterCard, Phonepe, Google, Apple, etc. The IIT BHU placement cell also arranges many workshops, soft skill development programmes, etc. to prepare the students for the future.   IIT Varanasi course admissions are conducted based on entrance exam scores and counselling. To be eligible for application, candidates must also meet the basic eligibility requirements for their desired programme. The applications are to be done online on the exam's official portal. The exams accepted for admission are JEE Advanced, GATE and IIT JAM.   IIT Varanasi NIRF Ranking: The institute was ranked in the 31st position in the Overall category with a score of 57.08. The university is a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and the International Association of Universities (IAU). DIT University is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) and Council of Architecture (COA). DIT University also received a BSI ISO 21001: 2018 certification. Students interested in learning foreign languages can enrol in the certification programmes run by the university.  DIT University admissions are offered on a merit and entrance basis. Students with exceptional academic records are offered scholarships at DIT University. The university has 5300+ students, 270+ faculty members out of which128+ are PhD degree holders and 17,000+ alumni. The campus is equipped with modern infrastructure and facilities such as smart classrooms, a playground for outdoor sports, a spacious auditorium, a well-stocked library etc. Other facilities offered by the university are the International Café, Open Air Amphitheater, Gymnasium, Convenience Stores, Medical facilities and security, etc.
